A word from our pastor

Welcome to Deeper Life Bible Church Lewisville

“At Deeper Life Bible Church Lewisville, you will never be lost in the crowd.”

Thank you for visiting us online. Founded by Pastor (Dr.) W. F. Kumuyi, Deeper Life Bible Church Worldwide is a Bible-believing church whose aim in all things is “achieving heaven’s goal.” Our Lewisville congregation is one of the branches in the Southwest Region, under the leadership of our Regional Overseer, Pastor Thompson Aderemi.

Our prayer and purpose are to bring people to Christ and help them grow in Him. Whether you are seeking a church home or have questions about Jesus Christ, we are here to serve you — as a church family where the pastor and members know and care for one another personally.

We look forward to welcoming you.

Meet our leadership What we believe
Your first visit

What to expect on a Sunday

Visiting a church for the first time can feel like a big step. Here’s what a Sunday looks like, so you can walk in already feeling at home.

About 2½ hours

Singing, prayer, Bible study and teaching

Parking and arrival

Free parking is in the lot around the plaza where we meet. Look for the large Deeper Life Lewisville sign in front of the building.

Kids & families

Children of every age are welcome in worship. During the service we also offer a safe, staffed Children’s Church for infants through 6th grade.

What to wear

Come as you are. You’ll see everything from Sunday best to comfortable clothes — we care far more about you being here than what you’re wearing.

How the service flows

Singing, prayer, Search The Scriptures and teaching. We pray together online at 9:00 AM before the service — you’re welcome to join us.
